person.name: Roman Mednitzer
person.headline: Senior Systems & Platform Engineer · Systems Integration
person.summary: Vienna-based senior systems and platform engineer with around ten years of production infrastructure experience. Works across infrastructure integration, reliable operations, automation, troubleshooting and recoverability, with explicit responsibility boundaries and evidence-led verification.
workingPrinciples: translate stakeholder needs into testable technical requirements within authorized scope
make decision authority, ownership, interfaces, unknowns and acceptance criteria explicit
integrate across disciplines and collaborate with domain specialists
contribute hands-on implementation when appropriate and verify the whole system
prefer concise operational procedures, evidence-led decisions, tested recovery and continual improvement
reduce single-person dependencies rather than rely on operational heroics
